name: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
summary: In Lakeshire, a handsome bounty calls for the death of Incinerator Gar'im. The hostile orc commander is entrenched in Render's Valley, where he leads shadowcasters and is said to work with the Blackrock clan at Stonewatch Keep. Magistrate Solomon offers the bounty for proof of Gar'im's demise.

sections.title: A Fire in Render's Valley
sections.body: Blackrock orcs are pressing out from their mountain strongholds, making the Redridge Mountains more dangerous. In Render's Valley, Gar'im leads an incursion with loyal shadowcasters and dark sorcery. Lakeshire's guard is stretched thin, and the crown's armies are largely absent. Magistrate Solomon has called on independent fighters to eliminate Gar'im, who is said to work with the Blackrock at Stonewatch Keep.

sections.title: Proof of Demise
sections.body: Gar'im is known for destructive magic and command over shadow-weaving casters. To claim the township's reward, hunters must enter enemy-held territory, defeat him, and return his shattered staff to Lakeshire's town hall as proof that the threat has ended.

faq.answer: Incinerator Gar'im is an orc warlord and spellcaster leading an incursion in Render's Valley. He is said to work with the Blackrock orcs of Stonewatch Keep and commands dangerous shadowcasters.

faq.q: Where can Incinerator Gar'im be found?
faq.answer: Gar'im camps among hostile orc forces in Render's Valley, in the southeastern Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Gar'im?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon posted the bounty on Lakeshire's behalf, hoping to stem the orc incursions bearing down on the embattled town.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon requires the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im as proof of the spellcaster's death before paying the reward.

faq.q: What threat do Gar'im and his followers pose?
faq.answer: Gar'im wields lethal destructive magic and is flanked by shadowcasters. Together, they strengthen the Blackrock clan's hold in Redridge and threaten to overwhelm Lakeshire if left unchecked.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire relying on bounties rather than the Stormwind army?
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Redridge largely to defend itself amid political strife and troop shortages. Magistrate Solomon has had to hire willing fighters to kill enemy leaders.

angles.text: Defeating Incinerator Gar'im protects Lakeshire's vulnerable citizens from the leader of an orc incursion and his dangerous shadowcasters.
Gar'im and his shadowcasters wield a corrupted form of offensive arcana and shadow magic, calling for a swift response with counter-spellcraft.
